name: All Items link in the burger menu navigates to the inventory page
description:
As a logged-in user
  I want to navigate between pages using the header
  So that I can access all areas of the application
descriptionHtml:
As a logged-in user
I want to navigate between pages using the header
So that I can access all areas of the application

testStage.description:
As a logged-in user
  I want to navigate between pages using the header
  So that I can access all areas of the application

steps.name: Given  a "standard" user is on the "login" page
When  the user adds "Sauce Labs Backpack" to the cart
And  the user clicks the cart icon
And  the user opens the burger menu
And  the user clicks all items in the burger menu
Then  the user should be on the "inventory" page
